Set or inspect ggsaveR options

Source: R/options.R
ggsaveR_options.Rd

A convenience wrapper around options() for the ggsaveR.* options. The new values are checked straight away, so a typo fails here rather than at the first ggsave() call. Setting an option to NULL restores its default.

Usage

ggsaveR_options(
  formats,
  size_suffix,
  dir,
  overwrite_action,
  variants,
  embed_data,
  embed_metadata,
  embed_max_size,
  creator,
  log
)

Arguments

formats

Save every plot in several formats and/or sizes. NULL (default), a character vector of devices such as c("png", "pdf"), or a list of lists, each with a device and any other ggsave() arguments, for example list(device = "png", width = 120, height = 80, units = "mm", dpi = 300). A format may also hold a suffix, such as "_slide", that is added to the file name.

size_suffix

Whether to add the size to file names, as in plot_120x80mm_300dpi.png. "auto" (default) adds it only where two formats would otherwise write to the same file; TRUE always adds it; FALSE never does.

dir

A directory for all plots. Relative file names are saved inside it, and it is created if needed. NULL (default) uses file names as given.

overwrite_action

What to do when a file already exists: "overwrite" (default), "unique" (add -1, -2, ... to the name) or "stop" (error before anything is written).

variants

Also save PNG copies that show how the plot looks without colour or to readers with a colour vision deficiency. Any of "greyscale" (or "grayscale"), "deutan", "protan" and "tritan". The colour vision simulations need the colorspace package. See preview_variants().

embed_data

If TRUE, embed reproducibility information in PNG files. See read_ggsaveR_data().

embed_metadata

Which parts to embed: any of "plot", "data", "session_info" and "call" (default: all).

embed_max_size

Largest size, in bytes, of the embedded plot object and data in one file (default 5 MB). Above it they are left out with a warning, while the call and session information are still embedded. Use Inf for no limit.

creator

A string stored as the Author of PNG files.

log

Path to a CSV file. Every saved file is appended to it as a row with time, path, size, resolution, MD5 checksum and the plot expression.

Value

With arguments, the previous values of the options that were changed, invisibly, in a form that can be passed to options(). Without arguments, a named list of the current values of all ggsaveR options.

Examples

old <- ggsaveR_options(formats = c("png", "pdf"), overwrite_action = "unique")
ggsaveR_options()
#> $ggsaveR.formats
#> [1] "png" "pdf"
#> 
#> $ggsaveR.size_suffix
#> [1] "auto"
#> 
#> $ggsaveR.dir
#> NULL
#> 
#> $ggsaveR.overwrite_action
#> [1] "unique"
#> 
#> $ggsaveR.variants
#> NULL
#> 
#> $ggsaveR.embed_data
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
#> $ggsaveR.embed_metadata
#> [1] "plot"         "data"         "session_info" "call"        
#> 
#> $ggsaveR.embed_max_size
#> [1] 5e+06
#> 
#> $ggsaveR.creator
#> NULL
#> 
#> $ggsaveR.log
#> NULL
#> 
options(old)
